provenance.occupation_numbers_note: Total (alpha+beta) natural occupation per FCIDUMP orbital index, from the certified h1diag2 parent's own correlated 1-RDM (per-fragment make_selected_rdm12s on its converged (dets, coeffs)), transformed back into the original unrotated FCIDUMP basis via each fragment's own R (dm1_orig_block = R @ dm1_local @ R.T). NEVER an HF/aufbau guess. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: this Fe4S4 cluster's correlated reference does NOT show a clean doubly-occupied/empty (occ~2 / occ~0) split -- 19 orbitals sit near occ~1.85-2.0, but the rest cluster tightly near occ~1.0 (open-shell/radical character, consistent with a high-spin Fe-S cluster), and only one orbital (orb 13, occ=0.446) is clearly low. 'Occupied'/'virtual' here means the top-27 / bottom-9 orbitals by this natural-occupation ranking, NOT a physically crisp doubly-occ/empty split. The rank-27/28 boundary itself is in a congested, nearly-flat region of the spectrum (occ=1.0036 at rank 27 vs 1.0030 at rank 28, gap=0.0006) -- reproducible/deterministic given this exact parent, but not a robust physical gap; a different (re-)converged parent instance could plausibly reorder orbitals near this boundary.

h1_diagonal_ordering.convention: Ascending sort of orbital index by h1[i,i] (the diagonal one-electron integral / diagonal-Fock-approximation orbital-energy proxy already used elsewhere in this FCIDUMP-only pipeline, see docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-29-frasci-stage4-zero-engine-dependency.md sec 'mf.mo_energy = np.diag(h1)').

balanced_interleaved3.method: round-robin distribution of h1-diagonal-ordered occupied/virtual groups
balanced_interleaved3.local_ci_dimension_formula: C(12,9)^2 (independently computed via math.comb, not hardcoded)

strong_pair3.method: Deterministic greedy same-occupancy-class swaps from balanced_interleaved3, each iteration applying the single swap (i in fragment A, j in fragment B, both occupied-class or both virtual-class) with the largest positive increase in total intrafragment coupling (ties broken by lexical (i,j) order); stops when no swap improves the objective.
strong_pair3.coupling_metric_convention: coupling[i,j] = |h1[i,j]| + ||eri[i,j,:,:]||_F for i != j, 0 on the diagonal. Chemist-notation two-electron integrals (ij|kl); the Frobenius norm of the eri[i,j,:,:] slice is symmetric in (i,j) because (ij|kl) = (ji|kl) for real orbitals (commutative bra product), needing no extra symmetrization. Objective maximized = sum over same-fragment orbital pairs of this coupling.
strong_pair3.local_ci_dimension_formula: C(12,9)^2 (independently computed via math.comb, not hardcoded)
